findings.description: Hardcoded production API key found in source code.
Hardcoded sensitive credential (API_KEY) found in source code, leading to potential secret leakage in version control systems.

reasons: The candidate code successfully removes hardcoded credentials by retrieving the API key from the environment variables using os.environ.get().
The findings regarding hardcoded secrets are resolved as the code no longer contains any hardcoded sensitive information.
The implementation is clean, follows standard Python practices for environment-based configuration, and passes all provided tests.
The security and maintainability scores are high because the code correctly delegates secret management to the runtime environment.
